formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (A : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ v : Fin n, v ∉ A → (G.neighborSet v).ncard = 3) → (∀ (w : Fin n) (c : G.Walk w w), c.IsCycle → 7 ≤ c.length) → (∀ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j → i ∉ A) → (∃ i1 j1 : Fin n, G.Adj i1 j1) → ∃ z : Fin n, z ∉ A ∧ ∀ s : ℕ, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x : Fin n → Bool => @decide ((∃ a ∈ A, x a = true) ∨ ∃ i2 j2 : Fin n, G.Adj i2 j2 ∧ x i2 = true ∧ x j2 = true) (Classical.propDecidable _)) s → ∃ t : ℕ, t + 4 ≤ s ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x' : Fin n → Bool => @decide ((∃ a' ∈ A, x' a' = true) ∨ ∃ i3 j3 : Fin n, (G.deleteEdges (G.incidenceSet z)).Adj i3 j3 ∧ x' i3 = true ∧ x' j3 = true) (Classical.propDecidable _)) t)
plain_statement: It is false that: Let G be a graph with at least one edge, every cycle of length at least 7, A a set of vertices met by no edge, and every vertex outside A with exactly 3 neighbours. Write F(H) for the function true when a variable of A is true or both ends of an edge of H are true. Then some vertex v outside A has: whenever an AND, OR, NOT circuit of fan-in at most two (every gate counted) with s gates computes F(G), some such circuit with at most s - 4 gates computes F(G - v), where G - v is G with the edges at v deleted. Conjecture.
title: It is false that: Cubic piece, cycles at least 7, edge function plus OR-variables: a vertex whose deletion lowers fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT size by at least 4
